name: Page 65537
source:
A Queen-like monster that possesses a book. Having possessed many different books up until now, her name is derived from how many different pages she has possessed. Boasting very powerful magic, any man who opens the book she is in will be quickly dragged into her world. Dragging them into her body, she is able to force any man to ejaculate. Any man caught by her will be forced to continuously ejaculate until nothing is left. Unusual among other monsters that possess books, she prefers to quickly squeeze her catches to death instead of keeping them alive.

In addition, it is extremely difficult to seal her. It appears as though someone created her with this particular characteristic, but the details are not known. It appears as though Page 65537 is on a quest to learn more about the meaning and purpose of her existence.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
